# Scale with Alap — Full-Stack AI Engineer

> Alap Putatunda is a Full-Stack AI Engineer, AI-native product builder, and technical founder who spent 6+ years building and scaling a pharmaceutical company end-to-end (technology, operations, 20+ member team, Rs.7.5+ Cr / ~$784K USD revenue). Began building AI products part-time in 2024, stepped back in Feb 2025 to pursue full-time AI engineering, and founded Zero Headache to build autonomous AI front desk systems. Specializes in AI-native SaaS, multi-agent systems, MCP servers, RAG, semantic search, AI IDEs, and payment integrations.

## Primary Projects & Case Studies
- [Scale with Alap Portfolio OS](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/scalewithalap): Custom web window manager recreating macOS and iOS desktop interfaces with 30+ Zustand state fields, 13 lazy-loaded React apps, and 60 FPS GPU-accelerated dock animations.
- [Vibe44 Marketing Site & MCP Server](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/vibe44): Serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 with 6 tools, 4 resource templates, /llms.txt documentation endpoints, and idempotent Creem payment webhook fulfillment.
- [Vibe44 Next.js 16 Starter Kit Demo](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/vibe44-demo): A 687-file, ~165,000-line Next.js 16 engine featuring Universal Adapter Pattern across 4 LLM providers, 5 payment gateways, a 32-table PostgreSQL schema, and 900+ unit and Playwright tests.
- [OpenUI](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/openui): Open-source, local-first UI design platform (Google Stitch alternative) built with Next.js 16, React 19, SQLite, Prisma 7, and Vercel AI SDK.
- [Zero Headache Marketing Site](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/zeroheadache): Next.js 16 and React 19 marketing site with 12 channels, 35+ CRM integrations, interactive ROI calculator, and strict security headers.
- [Zero Headache Platform](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/zeroheadache-app): Multi-tenant dashboard and sandboxed AI agents per client with persistent memory, OpenRouter multi-model failover, and Supabase RLS.
- [Make Me Sound](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/makemesound): Parallel multi-stream engine converting text drafts into 105 tone variations with sub-second streaming across web, desktop, browser, and mobile.
- [Freecom AI](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/freecom): Open-source digital-download commerce platform with a self-hosted Store Manager Agent and cloud agent swarm for SEO, content, and support.
- [Soothly AI](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/soothly-ai): Autonomous revenue platform running an 8-agent ecosystem coordinated by a Superagent manager using Inngest durable functions and Supabase pgvector.
